description: This file defines the AttendanceMarkScreen widget in Flutter, which allows users to mark student attendance by entering a student name, selecting a class period, and choosing a status (Present, Late, Absent). It interacts with the AttendanceProvider to persist data and includes UI elements like TextField, DropdownButton, and custom widgets OceanCard and OceanButton.

classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides UI and logic for marking student attendance.

methods.description: Manages state for the AttendanceMarkScreen, including user inputs, marking attendance, UI updates, and SnackBar notifications.

methods.description: Disposes of the TextEditingController to free resources.

methods.description: Displays a SnackBar with a message to the user.

methods.description: Handles marking attendance as present or absent, interacts with AttendanceProvider, and provides user feedback.
